A maikon feltrin serviços de engenharia e construção busca um profissional para atuar como servente de pedreiro, em regime de contrato determinado (presencial), com jornada de 44 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial.

A vaga exige experiência prévia e não há necessidade de viagens. A faixa salarial oferecida varia de R$ 2.000,00 a R$ 3.000,00. Habilitação para condução de veículos nas categorias A e B é necessária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  1. Preparação de materiais e insumos: Preparar e misturar argamassas, concretos e outros materiais de construção, conforme as especificações do pedreiro e projeto da obra. Organizar e separar os materiais de acordo com a necessidade de cada etapa da construção.
  2. Limpeza e organização: Manter o canteiro de obras limpo e organizado, removendo entulhos, materiais sobrantes e resíduos de construção. Responsável pela limpeza e organização das ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados na obra, garantindo sua conservação e disponibilidade para uso.
  3. Auxílio em tarefas de construção: Auxiliar o pedreiro em tarefas como a colocação de tijolos, blocos, argamassas, concretagem, pintura e outras atividades pertinentes à construção civil, conforme orientação e supervisão do pedreiro.
  4. Transporte de materiais: Transportar materiais e equipamentos dentro do canteiro de obras, utilizando equipamentos de movimentação de carga, quando necessário, sempre seguindo as normas de segurança.
  5. Cumprimento de normas de segurança: Seguir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança do trabalho, utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) fornecidos pela empresa. Reportar qualquer situação de risco ao superior imediato.
  6. Outras atividades: Realizar outras tarefas pertinentes à função, conforme demanda da obra e orientação do superior.

Requisitos:

  1. Experiência comprovada como servente de pedreiro.
  2. Habilitação para condução de veículos nas categorias A e B.
  3. Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial.
  4. Comprometimento com as normas de segurança do trabalho.
  5. Boa capacidade física para realização de atividades que exigem esforço físico.
  6. Organização, responsabilidade e proatividade.

Diferenciais:

  1. Conhecimento de diferentes tipos de materiais de construção.
  2. Experiência com diferentes tipos de obras (residenciais, comerciais, etc.).
  3. Conhecimento básico de leitura e interpretação de projetos.

title: Assistente de Proteção /RR
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, qualificada como Organização da Sociedade Civil de Interesse Público (OSCIP), constituída em 2007 para atuar com iniciativas de promoção do desenvolvimento de pessoas. Cumprindo sua missão de tornar as pessoas em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, a AVSI Brasil implementa projetos sociais construídos a partir de uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário. Nos últimos anos, a Venezuela tem vivido uma forte crise, ocasionando vulnerabilidade social e um contexto de emergência humanitária. A AVSI Brasil integra a resposta federal à emergência humanitária venezuelana da Operação Acolhida, formalizando um Termo de Colaboração com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social (MDS) para atuar em 4 (quatro) centros de acolhida (abrigos) para refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos na cidade de Boa Vista, em Roraima.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Assistente de Proteção atua sob a supervisão do(a) Coordenador(a) de Abrigo e com apoio e monitoramento técnico do(a) Oficial de Proteção Júnior e do(a) Oficial de Proteção Pleno. É sua responsabilidade apoiar na busca ativa e monitoramento de pessoas com necessidades específicas e fazer os devidos referenciamentos à equipe e parceiros da Operação, prestar informações à população atendida sobre a rede de proteção, apoiar ações de proteção baseada na comunidade e monitorar riscos e vulnerabilidades no abrigo.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o(a) Oficial de Proteção Pleno e o(a) Oficial de Proteção Júnior, reportando sobre o trabalho técnico de proteção;
  2. Manter contato direto com as pessoas de interesse para identificar os riscos e as necessidades específicas enfrentados por elas;
  3. Prover atenção e primeiros auxílios psicológicos às pessoas de interesse e/ou suas famílias;
  4. Apoiar na triagem entre novos abrigados de possíveis casos que necessitem de acompanhamento individualizado;
  5. Apoiar o monitoramento e a relatoria de indicadores de maior índice em violação de direitos no abrigo;
  6. Apoiar nos agendamentos com a van da organização, para transporte da população atendida;
  7. Identificar e encaminhar aos parceiros da Operação os casos de saúde que necessitam de apoio;
  8. Apoiar no acompanhamento externo de beneficiários, em ocasiões específicas, sempre que necessário.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados para atuar como a ponte entre os dados e o negócio, transformando informações em insights estratégicos para clientes e projetos. Essa posição tem como propósito principal usar dados para impulsionar inovação e evolução nas nossas entregas, trazendo valor agregado ao negócio.

RESPONSABILIDADES IMPORTANTES

  1. Compreender profundamente nosso modelo de negócios, as necessidades dos clientes e os objetivos dos projetos.
  2. Construir hipóteses e soluções personalizadas com base nas demandas específicas de cada cliente.
  3. Colaborar com Consultores de Negócios na definição de indicadores e construção de relatórios estratégicos.
  4. Desenvolver soluções inovadoras utilizando IA, Machine Learning e novas metodologias de análise de dados.

O QUE SERÁ ESPERADO NO DIA A DIA

  1. Realizar extração, tratamento, análise e interpretação de dados de campanhas e bases internas em alta escala.
  2. Construir e otimizar dashboards e relatórios que entreguem insights claros e acionáveis para diferentes stakeholders.
  3. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para análises em tempo real e batch, integrando diferentes fontes de dados.
  4. Projetar estruturas de banco de dados e implementar processos automatizados para melhorar a eficiência e a padronização do fluxo de dados.
  5. Aplicar análises estatísticas e algoritmos de Machine Learning para identificar padrões, prever tendências e embasar decisões estratégicas.
  6. Processar dados não estruturados em formatos utilizáveis e garantir a qualidade das análises entregues.
  7. Apoiar consultores de negócios e equipes multidisciplinares na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, alinhando entregas aos objetivos estratégicos dos clientes.
  8. Preparar relatórios gerenciais com métricas chave de desempenho (KPIs) para monitoramento de campanhas e tomadas de decisão.
  9. Participar de reuniões com clientes para mapear necessidades de dados e propor soluções tecnológicas inovadoras.

REQUISITOS

  • Proficiência em Python com foco em bibliotecas para análise de dados, como Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, e capacidade de desenvolver scripts eficientes para manipulação e visualização de dados.
  • Bancos de Dados: Habilidade para escrever consultas SQL complexas para operações de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga) em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.). Conhecimento em bancos não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB) e estruturação de dados no contexto de projetos de BI.
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios interativos com ferramentas como Tableau e Power BI, ou utilizando bibliotecas Python voltadas para visualização.
  • Estatística e Matemática: Entendimento avançado de conceitos estatísticos, como testes de hipóteses, análise de variância e modelagem preditiva. Familiaridade com probabilidade e álgebra linear para dar suporte às análises preditivas e exploratórias.
  • Machine Learning: Experiência prática com algoritmos básicos de aprendizado de máquina, incluindo regressão, classificação e clustering, com capacidade de implementar esses modelos em Python.
  • Big Data: Conhecimento em plataformas de armazenamento e processamento de dados como Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, ou sistemas on-premise (Hadoop, Spark). Habilidade em trabalhar com ferramentas para gerenciar grandes conjuntos de dados em tempo real ou em lote.
  • Segurança e Governança de Dados: Compreensão sólida de práticas de segurança, incluindo criptografia, anonimização, e conformidade com normas de proteção de dados (LGPD, GDPR).

DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e ambientes dinâmicos.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Cultura Remote First.
  • Zenklub (Sua saúde mental em 1° lugar).
  • Day Off aniversário (No dia do seu aniversário é folga).
  • Gympass (Licença de Academia).
  • Recesso (30 dias).

  • Licença Maternidade.
  • Cartão Flex (R$300,00 reais ao mês).
  • Flex Office (Quem mora na Grande São Paulo pode aderir ao Flex Office: Fazer Home Office e, quando quiser, trabalhar em nosso espaço de coworking).

title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing
description:
Tremendous is the fast, free, flexible way to send bulk payouts to people in over 200 countries. 10,000+ companies ranging from mom-and-pops to Google, MIT, and United Way have sent over $1 billion, saving 15 hours a month on average.

In both our product and our workplace, we’re intentional about making work more efficient, flexible, and fulfilling. Tremendous is a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life.

Our customers, who include marketers, UX researchers, HR teams and nonprofits, rave about how quick and easy it is to use Tremendous — check the ratings on G2. Yet there’s a lot of complexity under the hood, including over 2,000 redemption options and plenty of banking infrastructure. This duality makes working here a fun challenge.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Join us before the next international offsite!

About the role

We are hiring an experienced data analyst to partner closely with the marketing team, with a focus on attribution.

Tremendous values data as a first-class citizen and believes insights unlock significant growth. You will collaborate closely with the data team and company-wide stakeholders. As we continue to grow the business, you will scale marketing-focused insights and lead new data-driven initiatives.

In this role, you’ll get to

  • Apply various analytics methods to gain insights into all aspects of marketing, including multi-touch attribution modeling, predictive lead scoring, paid media ROI analytics (MMM and iROAS) and full funnel pipeline reporting.

  • Consolidate diverse facts and findings into compelling narratives that can be applied across Tremendous.

  • Advocate for data-informed decisions by partnering with key stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Identify and implement improvements within the Data team by standardizing processes, developing innovative practices, providing mentorship, and fostering new expertise.

  • Join a growing team of analysts and actively contribute to team collaboration and culture.

More about you

  • You have extensive experience with B2B marketing analytics, including paid acquisition and attribution, and you are familiar with related tools.

  • You write sophisticated SQL with a preference for well-architected data models, optimized query performance, and documented code.

  • You are proficient with at least one visualization & business intelligence platform (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Mode).

  • Strong verbal and communication skills. You can articulate why something should be built a certain way and how it will impact the business.

  • You expedite projects forward, favoring rapid and incremental development in parallel with problem-solving short-term obstacles.

  • You employ a structured approach to handle ambiguous exploratory analysis, balancing thoroughness with the MVP mindset.

  • You use data to achieve ambitious goals and influence company-level outcomes. Experience as a technical lead or manager is a plus.

  • You use excellent judgment and sharp business and product instincts that allow you to prioritize.

Bonus

  • Experience with forecasting and predictive modeling.

  • Experience with operational tools and systems like Segment, Amplitude and Hubspot (or other CRM tools).

  • Experience with dbt, Fivetran or Census.

  • Experience in Python or R.

What's cool about the role

  • You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.

  • Competitive pay, equity and benefits. The base salary for this role in Brazil is $110,000 - $150,000.

  • We're a remote company. Work from wherever you want in the Americas — we have collaboration hours from around 12-3 PM Eastern time.

  • Smart people and a great culture. See our company handbook .

title: System Engineer
description:
4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

The Systems Engineer with a focus on Hardware Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of complete systems integrating Clever Devices hardware products with complementary technologies to deliver robust and reliable solutions that meet customer requirements. This role involves the design of high-quality cable harnesses, component mounting solutions, and the validation of physical and manufacturing requirements, including safety, structural integrity, vibration, thermal performance, shielding, and operational efficiency.

The Systems Engineer works closely with project teams to analyze customer requirements and define functionality early in the project lifecycle. Responsibilities include creating design documents, system architecture, requirement matrices, and supporting customer design reviews. Additionally, the Systems Engineer oversees Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and System Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring successful system deployment at customer sites. The position requires collaboration with cross-functional teams such as Program Management, Product Management, Hardware Engineering, and Systems Engineering to deliver tailored solutions for the transit industry.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead system design, integration, and deployment, ensuring compliance with safety, structural, and operational standards.
  • Design and validate cable harnesses, component mounting solutions, and other hardware to meet form, fit, and function requirements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design drawings, schematics, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and installation instructions.
  • Conduct and review detailed analyses, acceptance test procedures, installation procedures, and operating procedures using relevant software tools.
  • Oversee system integration, FAT, and SAT processes, ensuring all phases of deployment meet customer expectations.
  • Manage and document system configurations while performing performance and reliability analyses for end-to-end protocols.
  • Supervise and train staff or contractors involved in retrofitting and installing Clever Devices equipment at customer locations.
  • Review and verify technical documentation to ensure correctness and accuracy in design outputs.
  • Support fast-paced, dynamic team environments, maintaining a focus on cost-effectiveness and manufacturability.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (required); Master’s degree preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data, and communication technologies.
  • Expertise in hardware design, including reading and interpreting electrical schematics.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience with 2D/3D CAD tools (e.g., Zuken E3, SolidWorks, AutoCAD); experience in cable harnessing and sheet metal is a plus.
  • Familiarity with J1939 and J1708 protocols and heavy vehicle wiring systems (e.g., transit buses or rail) is advantageous.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting, lab equipment, and network/protocol diagnostic tools.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, SQL) and report generation.

Capabilities:

  • Strong problem-solving skills, multitasking ability, and a creative approach to technical challenges.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on clarity and precision.
  • Ability to independently gather, document, and interpret technical requirements.

Physical Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel domestically at least (25%).
  • Ability to operate computer peripherals and view display terminals for extended periods.
  • Capable of lifting or pulling up to 15 pounds.

Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

title: System Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

Systems Engineer (Data Science Focus)

The Systems Engineer with a focus on Data Science is responsible for leading the deployment of integrated systems that include Clever Devices products and complementary technologies, delivering solutions tailored to customer requirements. This role combines expertise in systems engineering and data science to deploy hardware products, interfaces, and data-driven insights that enhance customer operations. The Systems Engineer collects, cleans, and analyzes transit-related data, applying advanced statistical techniques and machine learning models to provide actionable recommendations and optimize system performance.

The engineer collaborates closely with project teams to analyze customer needs, create design documents, system architecture, and requirement matrices, and support customer design reviews. Responsibilities also include conducting Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), System Acceptance Testing (SAT), and managing system development, integration, and configuration documentation.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of systems integrating hardware, software, and data technologies.
  • Collect, preprocess, and analyze data to identify trends and actionable insights.
  • Develop and implement machine learning models to support Clever Devices deployments and customer operational optimization.
  • Create data visualizations, reports, and dashboards to communicate findings and insights.
  • Coordinate system development tasks, including design, integration, and formal testing.
  • Produce and maintain programmatic and technical documentation (e.g., design documents, system diagrams, and requirement matrices).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data-driven solutions into Clever Devices’ Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) platform.
  • Conduct performance and reliability analyses for end-to-end protocols.
  • Identify areas for operational enhancement and propose corrective actions to improve customer metrics.
  • Provide training and guidance to junior team members and stakeholders.

Skills & Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

Experience:

  • 10+ years in systems engineering, including data science, hardware, software, and communication technologies.
  • 1+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning applications.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in statistical programming (Python, R, MATLAB, or SAS).
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with statistical techniques, data mining methods, and machine learning algorithms.
  • Experience with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project).
  • Knowledge of J1939 and J1708 protocols, with familiarity in hardware troubleshooting.

Capabilities:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret customer data and translate it into actionable insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage internal teams and external customers.
  • Ability to independently gather requirements, create technical documentation, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to influence stakeholders and drive operational improvements.

Physical Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel domestically at least 25%.
  • Ability to operate computer peripherals and view multiple display terminals for extended periods.

Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

Sr. Product Manager, Seller Experience, Latam Marketplace

Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Marketplace LatAm team! We are looking for talented Senior Product Managers. Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

The Senior Product Manager role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities and acumen. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable assessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with key business stakeholders and multiple partners to envision what will make Seller Listing experiences a success and shape analytical deliverables. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by the ambiguity or competing priorities to scale in different geographies. This means you are not only able to own high-level strategic initiatives, but also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Owning, building and driving the seller experience with key local and global stakeholders such as tech, legal, accounting, and operations.
  2. Manage prioritization and trade-offs to ensure the right features are built with the right quality at the right time.
  3. Driving decision making throughout the team.
  4. Partnering with global product teams to identify and influence development of new products and services.
  5. Addressing barriers through problem solving and coordination with stakeholders.
  6. Gain support for your strategy and roadmap from stakeholders by writing narratives and influencing peers and senior leadership.
  7. Creating goals and related metrics, track progress and manage through obstacles to achieve your objectives.
  8. Communicating performance, articulating root-cause analysis and linking to specific improvement areas.
  9. Incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class seller experience.

About the team

Inclusive and Diverse: We embrace our differences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, reminding members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance: We believe striking the balance between personal and professional life is critical to life-long fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours so you find your own balance.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We believe supporting new members is critical for team-wide success. We celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience.
  2. Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  3. Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
  4. Experience with end to end product delivery.
  5. Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
  6. Fluent in Business-level English, both written and oral.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
  2. Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  3. Fluent in Spanish.

description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Pipefitter will perform maintenance or construction welding tasking, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the Plumbing Foreman. Tasking is based on employee’s prior work experience and ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform pipe welding and structural welding tasks on maintenance and construction projects.
  2. Perform cutting, fitting/welding, connection, and installation of piping.
  3. Weld various types and sizes of piping, using multi-process techniques.
  4. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  5. Accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  6. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  7. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  8. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), suggest revisions as needed, and create SOPs as directed.
  9. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  10. Use solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  11. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  12. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  13. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  14. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).
  15. Occasionally utilize the assistance of other station personnel to complete tasking, or assist other trades or departments with their tasking.
  16. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  17. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.
  18. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.
  19. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Previous 6G welding certification at time of hire.
  3. Must pass a 6G welding certification exam prior to deployment.
  4. Minimum 4 years’ experience in pipe fitting and pipe welding work.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.
  2. Experience in construction and/or maintenance of commercial and/or industrial facilities.
  3. Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.
  4. Possess the competencies, willingness and ability to perform the duties of position.

Preferred:

  1. Experience working with a variety of pipe materials.
  2. Brazing experience.
  3. Rigging experience.
  4. Prior cold weather welding experience.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

title: Boiler Mechanic
description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Boiler Mechanic will perform hands-on boiler operation tasks on maintenance or construction projects, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the PM Foreman. Tasking is based on ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities:

  1. Diagnose, repair, and perform scheduled Preventative Maintenance on boiler systems: hydronic, hot water heaters, steam HVAC systems and associated equipment.
  2. Maintain boiler systems in accordance with provisions of the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code. Boiler systems may include steam, hydronic, hot water heaters, along with other types of heating systems, pumps, forced air furnaces, air handlers.
  3. Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot and repair station boilers and associated systems, heat exchangers, pumps, controls, air handlers, commercial steam kitchens, and zone valves in all buildings.
  4. Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot and repair circulating pumps, back-up pumps, heat exchangers, strainers, valves, expansion tanks, air separators, unit heaters, heating coils and system controls to assure adequate operations.
  5. Inspect all glycol and steam lines for damage.
  6. Perform preventive maintenance in accordance with the preventive maintenance program.
  7. Monitor, regulate and repair fuel lines and air adjustments for the boilers.
  8. Monitor, repair and maintain boiler control systems.
  9. Commission and startup new equipment.
  10. Submit reports as required by supervisor.
  11. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  12. Maintain accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  13. Advise Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  14. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  15. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), suggest revisions as needed, and create SOPs as directed.
  16. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  17. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  18. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  19. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  20. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  21. Other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Minimum 4 years’ experience in boiler operation and complete hydronic and steam HVAC systems maintenance and repair.
  3. Documented experience in construction, repair, and/or maintenance of commercial, residential, and/or industrial facilities’ boiler systems.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, diagrams, maintenance manual and manufacturer’s troubleshooting guides to accomplish tasking.
  2. Experienced developing written work plans, job hazard analysis, and job safety analysis related to the work activities under a permit to work system.
  3. Proficient in LOTO procedures for various tasking.
  4. Proficient in confined space safety protocols.
  5. Proficient in risk assessment and determination of PPE appropriate to specific tasking.
  6. Knowledgeable of limits of PPE and proper maintenance of PPE.
  7. Familiar with fall protection and respirator use.
  8. Competent analyzing situations and making technical and safety decisions based on specifications and applicable codes and manufacturer guidelines.
  9. Solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  10. Good organizational and planning skills.
  11. Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.

Preferred:

  1. Certificate in Steam Boiler Operation/Maintenance.
  2. ASSE 19210 hydronic Heating & Cooling Certificate.
  3. Experience with Microsoft Office Suite.
  4. Experience with Maximo or other Computerized Maintenance Management.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

A essência do cooperativismo é um modelo indiscutível de responsabilidade social.   • Auxiliar a área de vendas por meio da comercialização de produtos, faturamento de notas e transferência de mercadorias e produtos;

PRIVATE CLIENT

Together, our client-obsessed team creates an unrivaled, personalised shopping experience in the luxury fashion industry. We understand the international world of luxury fashion and lifestyle, and use this to provide an elite service focused on earning the heart share of our clients. One of our priorities is to retain top tier clients, increase the spending power of an existing client book along with engaging new clients, while developing potential clients. We approach every opportunity with innovation and develop loyalty through an understanding of personal style, lifestyle needs and brand/product preferences.

SÃO PAULO (Santos Augusta)

Our São Paulo office is located in the heart of the city, a location full of cultural spaces and history. The office has spaces for lectures and fun activities.

THE ROLE

Reporting to the Senior Regional Sales Manager, the Regional Sales Manager will enhance the Farfetch customer experience for our most valuable clients through leadership of the LATAM Private Client department. The focus will be placed on growing the country's top clientele, engaging new clients and increasing brand desirability. Responsibilities include managing team members to achieve and exceed goals. You have considerable team management experience (minimum 5 years), can manage sales turnover per annum and will demonstrate experience exceeding goals through your management skills.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • You will work with the PC leadership team to establish vision and build regional and global strategy in Private Client.
  • You will set and manage goals for a team of Senior Stylists, Stylists and Assistants, meeting with them to review performance against set goals.
  • You will develop the team, providing guidance and direction to help improve their sales techniques and general client management.
  • You will analyze sales reports, client books and client engagement/travel budgets.
  • You will work on customer acquisition strategies and projects, using professional and personal networks.
  • You will work with the Brand Marketing team on events, brand collaborations and partnerships to attract more top tier customers.
  • You will promote clienteling efforts that focus on growing and retaining our top clients.
  • You will work with the global Merchandising team to ensure maximum knowledge of forthcoming stock availability for customer benefit.
  • You will maintain general level of market competitor awareness on and off line through reference to other websites and editorial, and seasonal comparative shops.
  • You will attend brand events to aid in the development of the business and act as a Farfetch brand ambassador.
  • You will maintain basic team management standards with timekeeping, expense reporting, scheduling, and new hire training.
  • You will participate and present during All Hands monthly meetings, LATAM manager meetings, internal gatherings and global gatherings.
  • You will assist Director in annual PMP process.
WHO YOU ARE:

  • You have sales leadership experience in a related industry.
  • You have managed a team of direct reports.
  • You have commercial awareness with history of exceeding goals.
  • You have experience managing the business development process, as it pertains to sales executives and organizational/departmental goals.
  • You are well-versed in Salesforce and Excel.
  • You are highly strategic, with experience presenting at all levels.
  • You are able and willing to travel when necessary.

title: Operador de Supermercado - Valverde
description:
Organizar as mercadorias de forma atrativa, em pontos estratégicos de vendas. Abastecer pontos de venda, gôndolas e balcões, prestando serviços aos clientes na localização de produtos na loja e troca de mercadorias.

  • Verificar diariamente a validade de todos os produtos que fazem parte da seção onde o trabalho é realizado, informando imediatamente ao agente de prevenção de perdas ou encarregado de loja os produtos que se encontram para vencer no prazo de até 30 dias e retirá-los da área de venda para a área reservada às trocas e avarias antes que ultrapasse a data do vencimento.
  • Expor mercadorias nos pontos de vendas, promover a venda e demonstrar produtos para os clientes.
  • Receber mercadorias, requisitar e listar mercadorias para reposição.
  • Abastecer as gôndolas com mercadorias, seguindo o encarte e PVPS (Primeiro que Vence e Primeiro que Sai), conforme exposição pré-definida e sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar a conferência de precificação, trocar ou colocar etiquetas.
  • Organizar mercadorias de forma atrativa e colocá-las em pontos estratégicos de vendas com etiquetas de preço.
  • Prestar serviços aos clientes, tais como atendimento para sanar dúvidas, esclarecimentos sobre mercadorias e buscar mercadorias.
  • Examinar as condições das mercadorias (validade e estado físico) e organizá-las conforme o layout da loja.
  • Recolher mercadorias violadas ou com validade vencida e recolher mercadorias fora de lugar, repondo-as nas gôndolas corretas.
  • Sinalizar e comunicar ao encarregado de loja os produtos próximos de seus vencimentos, de modo a permitir a decisão de realizar promoções.
  • Evidenciar as mercadorias em promoção sinalizando-as para os clientes.
  • Realizar troca de mercadorias quando solicitado pelo cliente.
  • Conduzir os clientes até o local onde se encontra a mercadoria desejada.
  • Comunicar ao encarregado sobre a necessidade de reposição de mercadorias.
  • Arrumar as prateleiras, gôndolas e pontos extras no layout exigido, primando pela limpeza, aparência (beleza e fartura) e facilidade de transitar no setor.
  • Retirar as mercadorias do depósito para abastecer a loja e repor as gôndolas que encontram-se sem mercadorias.
  • Checar lista de alteração de preços e lista de mercadorias em promoção.
  • Manter livres os corredores de acesso, sem que haja alguma obstrução, tais como carrinhos ou cestas de supermercados.
  • Arrumar mercadorias no depósito, quando necessário.
  • Atuar como vendedor na relação com os clientes, procurando cativar a sua fidelidade.
  • Apoiar os colegas de outras seções, quando notar a necessidade de reposição de mercadorias.
  • Ser cortês, educado, bom ouvinte, empático e cooperar com o promotor a organizar seus produtos na loja, bem como verificar se pode solucionar problemas de ruptura de produtos procurados pelos clientes.
  • Relacionar-se com colegas do estoque, de modo a manter a fluidez da reposição de mercadorias e no retorno de materiais, tais como caixas, papelão e embalagens para o estoque.
  • Receber reclamações com serenidade e empatia, tentando solucionar o problema quando for simples fazê-lo; quando não, reportar-se à liderança para que possa finalizar o atendimento e resolver o problema, evitando embates com os clientes.
  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização de seu local de trabalho e locais de utilização comum, tais como refeitórios e banheiros.

title: Light Vehicle Technician (Levels I, II, & III) – Small Engine Field Support
description:
Responsibilities:

  1. Performs maintenance, diagnosis and repair of generators and small equipment, snowmobiles, and ATVs.
  2. Performs rebuilds on engines, drive trains or components or equipment.
  3. Provides training for personnel on the safe use of the above equipment.
  4. Performs on-site maintenance and repair to equipment in the field, as required.
  5. In field camps, works as Equipment Operator as required, including, but not limited to: grooming the skiway and loading/unloading aircraft.
  6. Trains camp staff on proper equipment and vehicle usage.
  7. Contributes to field camp end of season report, as required.
  8. Maintains detailed records on all work performed and completes work orders.
  9. Operates and maintains equipment including compressors, presses, air tools, electric power tools, forklifts, grooming equipment, etc.
  10. Assists MEC Shop Foreman/Camp Manager with daily operations.
  11. Maintains a clean, orderly and safe work area.
  12. Performs duties in support of metrics (as provided by the supervisor).
  13. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether they can be directly or indirectly affected by job duties.
  14. Complies with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals.
  15. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  16. Works to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  17. Maintains workplace program and ensures safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  18. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED
  2. Technician Level I: A minimum of two years’ experience in maintenance and repair of diesel and gasoline small engines and generators is required.
  3. Technician Level II: A minimum of four years’ experience in maintenance and repair of diesel and gasoline small engines and generators is required, or three years’ experience in maintenance and repair of diesel and gasoline small engines and generators with at least one season experience working on vehicles in Antarctica.
  4. Technician Level III: A minimum of seven years’ experience in maintenance and repair of diesel and gasoline small engines and generators is required.

Preferred:

  1. Training at a technical school
  2. Experience working on small engines and generators in Antarctica
  3. Experience in snowmobile or ATV maintenance and repair and/or maintenance of tracked vehicles such as Tucker Sno-Cats and Pisten Bullys
  4. Previous cold weather experience
  5. Wilderness First Responder Certification
  6. Experience with diesel, two and four stroke engines; maintaining small engines
  7. Experience with electrical power generation
  8. Experience rebuilding engines
  9. Experience rebuilding gear cases and drive trains
  10. Able to read and understand wiring schematics
  11. Able to teach end users how to use and field maintain equipment

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

title: Refrigeration Mechanic
description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Refrigeration Mechanics perform refrigeration repair and maintenance on maintenance and construction projects, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the Preventative Maintenance Foreman. Tasking is based on ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on refrigeration and cooling equipment in accordance with the preventive maintenance program. This includes installation and startup of refrigeration and cooling equipment utilizing special tools and equipment.
  2. Diagnose, repair, and perform scheduled Preventative Maintenance on existing refrigeration systems and equipment.
  3. Effectively communicate with affected parties regarding planned tasking, issues, or impacts.
  4. Advise the Preventive Maintenance Foreman on job progress and material/labor requirements.
  5. Maintain up to date refrigeration inventory.
  6. Assist Facilities Maintenance Supervisor and PM Foreman in determining materials for inventory re-supply.
  7. Order replacement parts as needed.
  8. Act as EPA required “Refrigerant Manager” for CFC tracking, leak detection, and reporting functions.
  9. Work with all electrical components from disconnect throughout equipment.
  10. Submit reports as required by supervisor.
  11. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  12. Accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  13. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  14. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  15. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and create or revise SOPs as needed.
  16. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  17. Use solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  18. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  19. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  20. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  21. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).
  22. Occasionally utilize the assistance of other station personnel to complete tasking, or assist other trades or departments with their tasking.
  23. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  24. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.
  25. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.
  26. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in refrigeration mechanic work, including installation and maintenance of refrigeration equipment.
  • Current EPA Section 608 Universal Technician Certification.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  • Ability to diagnose, maintain, adjust, repair, and replace refrigeration systems and components.
  • Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.
  • Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.
  • Possess the competencies, willingness, and ability to perform the duties of the position.

Preferred:

  • Experience in commercial and/or industrial facilities.
  • HVAC/R license/certification.

Responsibilities:

  1. Maintains a safe workplace program and ensures that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Complies with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements, goals, policies and procedures. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.

  5. Monitors diesel engine/generators and associated switch gear parameters.
  6. Monitors waste heat recovery system, wind turbine production and auxiliary equipment parameters.

  8. Maintains operating logbooks and databases as required.
  9. Starts, places in service and secures diesel generators as necessary.
  10. Maintains identified operational hours spread of diesel engine/generators to better forecast maintenance.
  11. Responds to unscheduled equipment failures with appropriate immediate and subsequent actions while on shift.
  12. Assists the Power Plant Mechanic with scheduled maintenance and repairs.
  13. Maintains cleanliness of Power Plant facilities including diesel engines.
  14. Advises the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative of the status of power production equipment and systems.
  15. Works a rotating shift; day, swing or night shift.
  16. Trains Power Plant Operators on mechanical equipment as directed.
  17. Complies with applicable Safety, Environment, Health, and Waste Management policies and procedures.
  18. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position’s work activities.
  19. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with their superiors and peers as needed to relay information they need in order to be successful in their jobs. This includes, but is not limited to, staff meetings, performance appraisals, job requirements, division metrics, projects, Quality Standard Procedures, and safety practices.
  20. May be required to work outside on various jobsites in extreme cold weather and environmentally challenging conditions.
  21. Interacts with other partner companies, the National Science Foundation, military and other agency officials, both over the telephone and in person. Is kind, courteous, cooperative and professional at all times.
  22. Participates in dormitory chores while deployed to Antarctica.
  23. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Minimum 2 years Power Plant experience required (Diesel, Gas Turbine, Nuclear, Hydroelectric or Renewable). Equivalent experience in diesel engine or electrical maintenance accepted in lieu of Power Plant experience.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Mechanical aptitude with the ability to handle multiple tasks at once is required.
  2. Working knowledge of the principles and practices applied in the operation of diesel electric generating equipment is required.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the methods, hazards, and safety precautions related to diesel engines and diesel engine driven electric generators is required.
  4. Ability to maintain a professional attitude and to work efficiently in a stressful environment is required.
  5. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

Preferred:

  1. High school graduate or GED.
  2. Previous experience with remote Polar Logistics operations.
  3. Diesel Power generation experience.
  4. Strong background in diesel engine and electrical troubleshooting.

title: Power Plant Electrician
description:
Job Responsibilities:

  1. Maintains a safe workplace program and ensures that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Complies with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements, goals, policies and procedures. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  3. Performs preventive maintenance and repair on all switchgear control circuits, generators, contactors and relays in accordance with procedures and manufacturers’ recommendations.
  4. Tests and repairs all safety circuits in generator and control units.
  5. Inspects electrical power generation systems to ensure that no faults exist.
  6. Monitors operation of all power generation electrical components to ensure proper operation.
  7. Monitors loading; operates power generation equipment in an efficient and economical manner.
  8. Completes maintenance records and maintains operating logbooks as required; documents all maintenance performed.
  9. Coordinates with the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative to order repair and/or spare parts, maintenance parts, assemblies, tools and consumables.
  10. Advises the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative of the status of power production stock, equipment and systems.
  11. Maintains control of Power Plant Electrician's tools and manuals.
  12. Maintains inventory accuracy at 98% or better.
  13. Trains Power Plant Operators and Mechanics on Power Plant operation and equipment as directed.
  14. Ability to cover Power Plant Operator shift/rounds as required.
  15. Supports the achievement of metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position’s work activities.
  16. Works to achieve goals and contractual commitments.
  17. Troubleshoots and repairs electrical problems.
  18. Willingness to work a rotating shift: day, swing or night shift.
  19. Responds to power outages and equipment failures as required.
  20. Evaluates job hazards and communicates information to staff verbally and in writing through various venues, including weekly and/or daily crew meetings.
  21. Interprets project tasking utilizing design drawings, specifications and diagrams.
  22. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with their superiors and peers as needed to relay information they need in order to be successful in their jobs.
  23. May be required to work outside on various jobsites in extreme cold weather and environmentally challenging conditions.
  24. Interacts with other partner companies, the National Science Foundation, military and other agency officials, both over the telephone and in person. Is kind, courteous, cooperative and professional at all times.
  25. Participates in dormitory chores while deployed to Antarctica.
  26. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. A current Journeyman Electrician license, a current Master Electrician license, or equivalent Union membership in good standing. A Journeyman license requiring less than 8,000 hours or of the Residential type shall not be considered.
  3. Minimum four years (8,000 Hours) documented experience in all phases of electrical work, with at least 2 of those years being in power distribution wiring, directly related power plant/electrical switchgear and control panel maintenance and repair.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read design drawings and wiring diagrams is required.
  2. Mechanical aptitude with the ability to handle multiple tasks at once is required.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the methods, hazards, and safety precautions related to diesel engines and diesel engine driven electric generators is required.
  4. Ability to maintain a professional attitude and to work efficiently in a stressful environment is required.
  5. Working comprehension of electrical distribution, control panels and medium voltage switchgear.
  6. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

Preferred:

  1. Previous experience with remote Polar Logistics operations is preferred.
  2. Experience working with AC and DC voltages from 12 up to 4160 is preferred.
  3. Mechanical, construction, or other industrial experience is preferred.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.
  8. Valid Driver’s License

As a member of our personal care and companionship team, you will do truly meaningful work—and be valued, respected, and heard. As a mission-driven, not-for-profit organization, we are committed to providing patients with the highest-quality care, enabling them to live safely at home with comfort, independence, and dignity. Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

You will engage with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. title: Nutricionista Clínica - Hospital Santa Ana
description:
Se você é apaixonado por cuidar de pessoas e quer fazer a diferença em uma Instituição com mais de 4 mil pessoas atuando nas áreas de saúde, educação e responsabilidade social, essa é a sua oportunidade!

O Nutricionista Clínico é responsável pela atenção nutricional integral ao paciente, incluído o diagnóstico, definição do plano terapêutico nutricional, o monitoramento da alimentação na internação, e o processo de educação nutricional para continuidade do cuidado, visando manter ou recuperar o estado nutricional dos pacientes internados ou ambulatoriais, de todos os setores do Hospital Santa Ana, sempre em consonância com a Missão, Visão e Valores éticos, morais e humanos, fundamentados nos valores da Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo Scalabrinianas.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a atenção nutricional integral ao paciente por meio da avaliação nutricional, do diagnóstico, da prescrição da dietoterapia, da recomendação de técnicas dietéticas, e do seguimento terapêutico ao longo da internação;
  • Conduzir as ações de educação nutricional por meio do aconselhamento de pacientes, familiares e cuidadores, da preparação para o autocuidado domiciliar, do desenvolvimento de atividades de ensino, pesquisa, controle e análise do desempenho assistencial;
  • Controlar o estoque de insumos e correlatos necessários para o plano nutricional do paciente, por meio de adoção de inventários, do controle de prazos e validades, do descarte adequado, e da aplicação de técnicas de segurança alimentar e vigilância nutricional;
  • Preservar a integridade do paciente mediante a adoção e o cumprimento de processos de qualidade e segurança, da ética profissional, dos protocolos institucionais, dos procedimentos operacionais técnicos (POT), da vigilância em saúde, da Política HumanizaSUS e do acompanhamento dos indicadores assistenciais e de resultado;
  • Assegurar os registros nutricionais por meio do relato das ações de cuidados e procedimentos do plano dietético, e da supervisão das informações e procedimentos executados pelas equipes multiprofissionais;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e supervisão de estagiários de nutrição.

Requisitos

  • Curso Superior em Nutrição;
  • Desejável especialização em nutrição clínica e/ou paciente crítico/UTI;
  • Desejável experiência no setor/área de atuação.

Benefícios

  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Seguro de vida MetLife;
  • Teleatendimento em saúde mental 24h, extensivo a familiares.

Sobre a AESC

Fundada em 1962, a AESC tem sua origem na Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo-Scalabrinianas, presentes no Rio Grande do Sul desde 1915, e que aqui se estabeleceram com o propósito de acolher e cuidar, de modo particular, pessoas migrantes fragilizadas na sua condição socioeconômica e cultural, desde seus países e localidades de origem.

Hoje somos mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras nos segmentos de educação, saúde e responsabilidade social.

Nossa unidade de responsabilidade social está presente na cidade de Caxias do Sul, com o Centro de Atendimento ao Migrante.

Nossas unidades de educação estão presentes nas cidades de Farroupilha, Colégio Nossa Senhora de Lourdes, em Caxias do Sul, Colégio São Carlos, e em Santa Vitória do Palmar, Colégio São Carlos.

E nossas unidades de saúde estão presentes nas cidades de Porto Alegre, com hospitais e serviços de referência no RS e no Brasil, Hospital Mãe de Deus, Hospital Santa Ana e Centros de Atenção Psicossocial. Na cidade de Capão da Canoa, Hospital Santa Luzia, e na cidade de Torres, Hospital Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes.
